caption:
ACA benchmark premiums are up about 42% since 2025. 😬
KFF says 2027 alone adds another 13% on average, after the extra tax credits expired.
A $400 plan at that pace would now be $568 a month.
If you buy your own plan, what did your renewal notice say?
first_comment: Did you compare plans this year or just let it auto-renew? 👇
